in_latin.name: Elva
in_latin.meaning: name meaning 'all' or 'whole' possibly derived from Latin 'omnis' or 'totalis'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elva significat totum vel completum, potissimum a Latina 'omnis' vel 'totalis' derivatum. Originem trahit a nomine totius, quod totum significat. In Christiana traditione, nomen Elva significat totum Christum, totam salutem, et totam gratiam Dei. In cultura populari, nomen Elva significat universalitatem, completitatem, et perfectitatem.
